description: RAPID Collaborative Research: Spatial variability of small-strain stiffness, Go, and the effect on ground movements related to geotechnical construction in urban areas (field and laboratory seismic studies) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Kenneth Stokoe, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). Spectral-Analysis-of-Surface-Waves (SASW) tests and 3-D Full Waveform Inverstion (FWI) tests conducted at the construction site of the new Washington State Convention Center (WSCC) Building are presented in this project. The WSCC Building is located in downtown Seattle, WA. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: 3D FWI, SASW, RCTS, Go, Excavation. Published 2020-06-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
